name: Samwell Staxford
backstory: Samwell Staxford, named in-game as Dead Zealot of the Absolute, was an Absolutist zealot on the Rosymorn Monastery Trail during Act One. After he accidentally stumbled upon hostile githyanki youth, he raised a group of undead Death Shepherds and Ghouls to assist him but ultimately perished in the ensuing fight.
